name: Aarav's Confidence
story: Aarav was always hesitant to read aloud in class. Over time, with encouragement and practice, he started participating more. By the end of the year, he confidently read a full paragraph without hesitation.

name: Meera's Breakthrough
story: Meera struggled with writing full sentences. With consistent practice and engaging activities, she wrote a short story on her own, a milestone that amazed both her teachers and peers.

name: Jay's Progress
story: Jay found it difficult to focus in class. Through interactive lessons and patience, he improved his attention span and began actively participating in discussions.
